body:
From tackling personal decisions to reaching important milestones, my job is to guide you on the path of sustainability towards success. I have PhD in Biology and 28 years of experience in progressively senior levels of responsibility at universities and international environmental organizations. As a professional Senior Environmental Consultant, I guarantee great results.

I’m offering services in leading environmental non-profits, programme and project management and environmental research. I’m fueled by my commitment to excellence and go the extra mile to make sure clients are fully satisfied with my work. Get in touch with me today for a free consultation.

services.title: Leadership and Governance
services.summary: I help organisations set priorities, build partnerships and lead change. Drawing on leadership roles in academia, business and international cooperation, I bring strategic direction, inclusive governance and experience guiding multicultural teams.
services.description:
My leadership experience spans entrepreneurship, academic innovation and international environmental cooperation. As founder of Partner Consulting, former Deputy Executive Director of the Regional environmental Center, and former Director of the Innovation Center at the Faculty of Biology, University of Belgrade, I have worked at the intersection of science, public institutions and business.

Within SKILLS project, I support cross-border governance, policy dialogue and cooperation among universities, ministries, regional authorities and blue economy stakeholders. My work on the BLUECONNECT project and the Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster (ABGC) connects institutions and businesses around shared development priorities, research and innovation.

I help clients define strategic priorities, establish cooperation arrangements and mobilise expertise and resources. My approach combines clear responsibilities with participatory decision-making, helping diverse partners move from shared ambitions to coordinated action.

services.title: Project and Programme Management
services.summary: I have managed more than 100 projects with a combined portfolio exceeding €50 million. I support clients throughout the project cycle—from concept development and partnership building to implementation, budget oversight, reporting and evaluation—with particular expertise in EU-funded programmes.
services.description:
I bring extensive experience in managing international environmental and development projects involving public authorities, universities, businesses and civil society. My work covers project design, partnership coordination, work planning, financial monitoring, reporting, risk management and evaluation.

Recent assignments include SA SKILLS, an Interreg IPA South Adriatic project strengthening blue economy skills and education, and BLUECONNECT, an Interreg IPA Croatia–Bosnia and Herzegovina–Montenegro project linking research, innovation and business cooperation. Within REDEEM, and Interreg Adrion project, I coordinate an expert assignment supporting Montenegro’s Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management on climate resilience and the water–energy–food–ecosystems nexus.

I help clients turn complex programme requirements into practical work plans, clear deliverables and reliable reporting processes. Particular attention goes to partner coordination, early identification of delays and maintaining consistency between activities, budgets and expected results.

services.title: Blue Economy and Skills Development
services.motto: Building Capacity for a Sustainable Adriatic
services.summary: I help institutions, businesses and research organisations advance a sustainable blue economy. My services connect marine research, aquaculture and coastal tourism with innovation, cluster development and skills programmes that respond to labour market needs.
services.description:
I work across blue economy governance, research–business cooperation and education, helping partners connect sector development with the knowledge and competencies it requires. My experience includes marine science communication, aquaculture, sustainable coastal tourism and collaboration among public authorities, academia, industry and civil society.

Within SA SKILLS, I contribute to policy development, stakeholder engagement, monitoring and evaluation, and the development of the South Adriatic Blue Qualification Framework (SA BlueComp). This work connects evidence on industry needs with competence descriptions, training priorities and cooperation between education providers and employers.

Through BLUECONNECT, I support the development of the Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster and its digital platform, creating opportunities for knowledge exchange, innovation and business cooperation. My involvement in Aquarium Boka adds experience in connecting marine research with education and public engagement. I help clients design partnerships, assess skills needs and develop training and collaboration initiatives grounded in regional opportunities.

services.title: Environmental Research and Policy
services.summary: I combine scientific expertise with practical experience in biodiversity, water management, environmental security and local sustainability planning. I help clients assess challenges, engage stakeholders and translate research into policies and actions.
services.description:
My work connects an academic background in biology with applied environmental research and policy support. I have contributed to initiatives addressing biodiversity, water resources, environmental security and participatory planning, combining scientific evidence with institutional knowledge and community priorities.

Through the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe, I worked on environmental action planning, water management and local water security initiatives, including programmes supported by Sida. Cooperation with the European Centre for Nature Conservation (ECNC) included developing a methodology for local biodiversity action planning.

My current work within REDEEM applies an integrated water–energy–food–ecosystems perspective to climate risks and rural development. This includes stakeholder mapping, consultation and methodological support for assessing interconnected environmental challenges. I help clients develop evidence-based assessments, practical policy recommendations and monitoring approaches suited to their decision-making needs.

services.title: Climate and Energy Planning
services.summary: I support local authorities and partners in developing Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans (SECAPs). Through stakeholder engagement, capacity building and technical coordination, I help translate climate and energy goals into practical mitigation and adaptation measures.
services.description:
As Country Team Leader for Serbia within the GIZ SECAP initiative, I coordinate support for local energy and climate planning. My work brings together municipal teams, technical experts and stakeholders to strengthen planning capacity and connect local priorities with climate mitigation and adaptation objectives.

I help authorities organise the planning process, coordinate technical inputs and develop measures with clear responsibilities and monitoring arrangements. Stakeholder participation is central to this approach: effective plans need both sound evidence and the involvement of the institutions and communities responsible for implementation.

My work within REDEEM complements this experience by addressing climate resilience through the water–energy–food–ecosystems nexus. It also includes methodological work on carbon footprint monitoring for project activities and an irrigation pilot. Together, these assignments support an integrated approach to local climate action, resource efficiency and resilience.

recommendations.author: Dr Anders Jägerskog, Senior Water Resources Management Specialist at the World Bank
recommendations.summary: Radoje is a dedicated professional that approaches the tasks set before him in a structured and professional manner.
recommendations.body: Radoje is a dedicated professional that approaches the tasks set before him in a structured and professional manner. He is able to work in challenging circumstances and still be able to deliver high quality outputs prepared by himself and his team. Radoje cooperates well with other actors and keeps abreast of developments in the project he was managing. He is also a good Communicator who is able to rally support behind the project often utilising a range of tools and approaches.

recommendations.author: Ilija Djekic, Associate Professor at University of Belgrade - Faculty of Agriculture
recommendations.summary: I was in touch with Radoje several times during my professional careers.
recommendations.body: I was in touch with Radoje several times during my professional careers. Back in 2002, as Regional Manager for Eastern Europe in American Quality and Environmental Group (AQE Group) I enjoyed communication with him while he was a trainee ISO 14000. He distinguished himself with excellent communication skills, effective public speaking and presentation skills, and pronounced complex problem solving and critical thinking. I was also following his career in the Regional Environmental Center (REC), where he demonstrated advanced management and coordination skills and fully target orientation. I also know him as one of the most knowledgeable person in environmental and sustainable development issues. Radoje could be a valuable asset to a company team striving to build sustainable communities, and support initiatives that reduce company’s environmental footprint.

recommendations.author: Rob Wolters, Executive Director ECNC and Chief Executive ECNC Land & Sea Group
recommendations.summary: Radoje Lausevic is one of the most experienced people in the field of sustainability, climate change and the environment in the wider Europe but also the world.
recommendations.body: Radoje Lausevic is one of the most experienced people in the field of sustainability, climate change and the environment in the wider Europe but also the world. He combines leadership and vision with practical approaches that work in the realities of everyday life of institutions, governments and wider stakeholders. He is a very experienced and professional manager, capable over overseeing a wide range of issues, including programme development and implementation, and donor-relationships. Radoje is an excellent negotiator, result-driven and with his eyes always on the ball. He has proven wide experience as project director of multimillion projects and can think out-of-the box.

recommendations.author: Kristina Salomonsson, Human Security Adviser / Focal point Latin America at Sida
recommendations.summary: Radoje is a highly professional person with excellent knowledge of development issues. He can conduct policy dialogue at government and non-government levels with strong objectivity and professional integrity.
recommendations.body: Radoje is a highly professional person with excellent knowledge in development issues. He demonstrates ability to conduct policy dialogue at government and non-goverment levels with high sense of objectivity and professional integrity. Radoje has excellent project management skills and works well under pressure and short deadlines. He was continuously delivering high quality outputs on the projects he was managing. He also confirmed himself as very efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results. He speaks and writes clearly and efficiently. I am highly recommending Radoje.

recommendations.author: Nela Jović, Development worker
recommendations.summary: I know Radoje for quite some time.
recommendations.body: I know Radoje for quite some time. He was my teaching assistant during my study at the Faculty of Biology. Then we cooperated when I was working for Sida - he was a regional director of REC and this organization implemented project of Swedish support to environmental civil society organizations in the WB region. Most recently, I had the pleasure of working with Radoje during the implementation of the Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center 'Boka Aquarium' (MonteAqua) project, funded by the Norwegian Embassy in Belgrade and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development of Montenegro. As project manager, Radoje demonstrated strong leadership, ensuring achieving the agreed objectives. Under this project, the first public aquarium in Montenegro was established, along with a rescue center for endangered marine animals, contributing to both biodiversity conservation and tourism development. Radoje has excellent coordination and communication skills, and he was instrumental in attracting other donors to join the effort of creating larger and lasting impact. I highly recommend Radoje for any future environmental and marine conservation endeavors.
